topic: A person finds out their surprise party has been cancelled
text: I can't believe this. All that planning, all those promises, and now it's just been called off like it's nothing. I get a text, a simple, cold text, saying "Sorry, had to cancel the party. Too much going on." Too much going on? What, did the universe decide it was too busy to handle one little celebration? I've got half a cake in the fridge, decorations crammed in a box, and now this. Well, they'll regret this, I can promise you that. Next time they want to pull a surprise, maybe they'll think twice before they go and back out on me.
